java_process_model: Fresh JVM per sample; startup and JIT compilation included
execution_modes: Both x2c columns parallelize binarytrees, fannkuch N>=9, Mandelbrot N>=256, regex counts >=65536 bytes and seven k-nucleotide widths. Spectral uses six workers at N>=256 idiomatic and N>=500 tuned. Other programs are serial.
foreign_measurements: Pinned calibration; not remeasured in this x2c update
normalization: Per-problem minima among available columns; all eight for shared problems
summary: Geometric mean of the eight shared normalized problem values
profile_centres: Arithmetic means, following the historical star-plot form
runtime: Median wall-clock elapsed time from the existing report
loc: Nonblank source lines after language-aware comment removal

binarytrees.python: Current archived #2 and base/#4/#5 reuse a constant tuple at leaves, violating the required per-node leaf allocation. #3 allocates fresh list leaves but explicitly disables GC; it is excluded under the pinned default-GC-when-possible guidance. The leaf violation was reproduced; the GC exclusion is an interpretation of that guidance. No official source was patched.

knucleotide.cpp: All three current contributed C++ variants require <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>, which the configured Apple libc++ toolchain does not provide. No GCC/libstdc++ toolchain is installed. Sources were not rewritten and no compiler/stdlib was installed.
knucleotide.go: All five unchanged official Go candidates fail ascending key ordering for equal frequencies. #3/#4/#6 explicitly sort descending keys; #7/#8 sort only counts and inherit randomized map iteration. #3/#4/#6/#7 use compressed nucleotide keys; all count all sliding windows in growing maps and handle missing requested fragments as zero in the tested legal tied sequence.
knucleotide.java: All six archived Java contributions fail required behavior on legal inputs: base/#8 misorder lexical ties; #6 drops tied keys; #4/#5 throw NullPointerException for missing target fragments; #3 returns zero for uppercase present target fragments. Sources were not patched.
knucleotide.rust: All eight Rust contributions in the pinned archive fail the specification requiring ascending lexical keys for equal frequency counts. They remain excluded without source edits.
